ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read the contour map of annual precipitation and annual mean temperature in a local region of a certain continent, and answer the question. <image1> The western section of the 25°C isotherm in the figure is mainly affected by what factor?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a contour map of annual precipitation and annual mean temperature in a local region of a certain continent. The left side is near the west coast of the continent, and annual mean temperature isotherms labeled 20°C and 25°C can be seen in the figure. The western section of the 25°C isotherm is close to the west coast of the continent and bends clearly near the west coast, appearing to protrude toward lower latitudes. Then reason: at the same latitude, if the coastal temperature on the west coast of the continent is relatively low, the position reaching 25°C will be pushed toward lower latitudes. According to the rules for interpreting isotherms, the passage of a cold current will lower coastal temperatures and make isotherms bend toward lower latitudes. Therefore, the western section of the 25°C isotherm in the figure is mainly affected by a cold current.

method.method_draft: 读取题目要求判断25°C等温线西段的主要影响因素；再观察图像中25°C等温线西段在大陆西岸附近发生向低纬度方向的弯曲，说明西岸沿海气温低于同纬度内陆或东侧地区。应用等温线判读规则：寒流经过会降低沿岸气温，使等温线向低纬度凸出。因此判断该西段主要受寒流影响。

图中25°C等温线西段主要受什么因素影响？
raw_record.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a contour map of annual precipitation and annual mean temperature in a local region of a certain continent. The left side is near the west coast of the continent, and annual mean temperature isotherms labeled 20°C and 25°C can be seen in the figure. The western section of the 25°C isotherm is close to the west coast of the continent and bends clearly near the west coast, appearing to protrude toward lower latitudes. Then reason: at the same latitude, if the coastal temperature on the west coast of the continent is relatively low, the position reaching 25°C will be pushed toward lower latitudes. According to the rules for interpreting isotherms, the passage of a cold current will lower coastal temperatures and make isotherms bend toward lower latitudes. Therefore, the western section of the 25°C isotherm in the figure is mainly affected by a cold current.
